notes: x86-64 Linux, NASM syntax, no libc: only the mmap, write and exit syscalls.
The N + 1 flag bytes come from an anonymous mmap (zeroed pages); rep stosb marks 2..N as prime.
Crossing off and the scan are plain byte loops; count, sum and largest live in callee-saved registers.
Division by 10 via multiplication by the reciprocal 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCD; one write for the whole output.
